8). Are Memecoins the Future?

Believe it or not, memecoins are evolving.

•Some (@Shibtoken, @bonk_inu) are building real utility
•Others (@dogecoin) are getting integrated into payments
•Some even form their own economies (like @pepecoineth and @itsafwog in NFT culture)

3). How Memecoins Exploded!

After Dogecoin, the floodgates opened.

•$SHIB (@Shibtoken)
•$PEPE (@pepecoineth)
•$WIF (@dogwifcoin)
•$BONK (@bonk_inu)

Each coin had one thing in common: community-driven hype.

And sometimes, that’s all you need.

2). The First Memecoin: @dogecoin 🐶

Dogecoin ($DOGE) started as a joke in 2013. Two engineers, @BillyM2k & @ummjackson, created it as a fun alternative to Bitcoin.

No serious tech. No real-world use case.

Just vibes.
